performance_optimization.priority: Unified branch versus the corresponding valid base, with GPU/CPU throughput secondary
performance_optimization.assessment: All final paired branch comparisons are faster: CPU 1.2-2.0%, normal ACC 8.3-13.9%, normal OMP 5.3-7.8%, tiled ACC 1.0-2.4%, tiled OMP 5.2-13.8%. ACC tiling uses optional driver-owned resident model sources to match its base; default bounded staging remains available and retains small regressions at execution widths 1024/2048. OMP tiling uses the valid equivalent-width unbatched control because the upstream packed path fails numerical validation. Host/device memory stays within 5% of valid bases. The inherited full-domain CPU/GPU LW tolerance miss remains unresolved.

initial_sp_performance_assessment.resource_share: Half node: 64 physical EPYC cores or two A100 GPUs
initial_sp_performance_assessment.headline: Default CPU/ACC/OMP times broadly retained; ACC tiled path 2.80x slower than the tiled fork. OMP integration is 11.65% slower than a valid equivalent-width large-block fork control; the fork's own packed path produces invalid near-zero fluxes and is excluded.
initial_sp_performance_assessment.memory: Host RSS broadly stable. ACC sampled device peak rises by 226 MiB/GPU in both compared execution modes; OMP rises by 48 MiB/GPU untiled and 54 MiB/GPU versus the equivalent-width control.
initial_sp_performance_assessment.numerical_followup: On this larger input, current matched-sampler CPU/device LW differences reach about 0.0038 W/m2, exceeding the small-case 0.001 W/m2 threshold. Detailed errors and invalid baseline exclusions are recorded in the assessment.

blocked_driver_execution_tiles.control: ECRAD_FULL_BATCH_SIZE=K, using the same execution_blocksize helper as the flat drivers; unset, empty or zero retains per-block execution.

implementation.gather: Map only the current contiguous source-block run through an explicit-shape dummy, gather inputs on device and zero outputs/padding. Release the source mapping before physics scratch allocation; do not map the entire model domain.
implementation.scatter: Download contiguous tile output fields, then scatter active rows into the original host block layout. Avoid runtime-dependent strided transfers across blocks.
implementation.seeds: Pass explicit tile seeds in both build modes: original input seeds under BITIDENTITY_TESTING, original block-local jcolumn otherwise.
implementation.host_metadata: Mirror the top two pressure half-levels from original host blocks for radiation_scheme's vertical-order check.
implementation.ownership: The driver creates and deletes its execution scratch mappings. Each gather owns only its temporary source mapping; no persistent module ownership flag is introduced.
